title: Guidance of the Spirit
definition: The guidance of the Spirit is His work of leading believers according to God's Word, wisdom, holiness, and truth.
summary: The Spirit guides God's people, but never in contradiction to Scripture. He leads believers toward Christ, obedience, wisdom, and faithfulness.
christFocus: The Spirit guides believers into truth that honors Christ and strengthens their walk with Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Spirit guides God's people, but never in contradiction to Scripture. He leads believers toward Christ, obedience, wisdom, and faithfulness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
